procedure_checks: Install requires explicit install approval, fresh result path, full current/staged/recovery comparisons, copy+sync success and full installed readback.
Shutdown requires separate explicit install-and-shutdown approval, expected installed hash, no earlier attempt, root-only mount and successful sync; attempt recorded before send.
Physical halt is not inferred from telnet loss; BOOT-mode user confirmation is a separate gate.

Flash requires recorded verified kernel installation and prior shutdown gates, user BOOT confirmation, expected chip/BOOTSEL/16MiB, exact previous firmware verification, fresh full-flash save -a -v, then exact candidate load -v.
Partial install/flash attempts remain recorded and block automatic retry.
limitations: Approval is for the prepared procedure, not permission to install/shut down/flash. User readiness/authorization still required.
State kernel_installed must be set only after complete=true and exact installed readback in kernel-install-result.json.
Any unexpected disconnect/failure must stop for evidence review; do not automatically rerun or infer halt.
Native clean-hotplug behavior remains unqualified until the planned bounded hardware tests.
